versions.content: Request mode change The ability to request a mode (i.e. the second use case) is modeled on the VFB via a SenderReceiverInterface and for the RTE it is like a usual communication, that means the connector can also cross ECU boundaries and the communicated dataElement s have to be based on Au- tosarDataType s.
